title: Crosby: I was 'livid' when Ravens nixed trade

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Crosby: I was 'livid' when Ravens nixed trade
sources.description: Raiders defensive end Maxx Crosby said he was "livid" and "confused" by the Ravens' decision to back out of a trade that would have sent him to Baltimore in exchange for two first-round picks due to medical concerns.
